svg.title: A prover in fresh sessions: the context never rots
svg.text: A prover in fresh sessions: the context never rots
Each session starts empty from the file as left, short notes and a state card; inside a session, edits are small and old check results are masked.
ACROSS SESSIONS: A FRESH CONTEXT EACH TIME
m0-loop.md, "A prover" and "The state card"
JOURNAL: WHAT THE NEXT SESSION STARTS FROM
INSIDE A SESSION
m0-loop.md, "The edit tool", "Masked old checks"; lean.md, "Bounded checks"
Session 1
a fresh context. The opening message
holds the theorem, the file (at first
sorry) and what Lean said of it
Session 2
a fresh context again, opened with the
file as the last check left it, the model's
notes and, in v2, the state card
Session k
the same, until a check passes, or turns,
context, the budget or the sessions run
out: stoppedBy in attempt.finished
The file as left
the AUX and PROOF regions of the last check
and the text of that check, as blobs
Notes: lesson.recorded
the model's last message, rewritten in full
and cut at notesChars; 1500 characters
when the card is on
State card (v2)
built from the journal by code, no model:
goal, holes, accepted lemmas, failed
approaches with counts, timeouts
patches the region as last checked; old must
occur exactly once, else not found or
found N times and nothing is checked.
On success it runs the same check as
lean_check, and the journal is unchanged
8 oldest: one line each
last 4: whole
A bounded Lean check
lean_check and lean_edit end in the fast check,
bounded at the host's checkTimeoutSec (120 s):
"did not finish" costs one turn, not 300 s.
A check with holes or without an answer is no
validation
A first valid check wins
validation.finished: the claim is computed;
the session ends, the problem's other
provers abort; the certifier decides
context, with its checks

context, with its checks
carry out
carry in

carry in
Why: output tokens were about 90% of the dollars
of the first real runs, the file being rewritten
whole at every check.
What the model is sent of 12 checks
In batches of four, so the cached prefix survives;
none masked below 8 results. The journal keeps all.
